justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/datamatrix/decoder/{Decoder.java,BitMatrixParser.java,DataBlock.java,Version.java,DecodedBitStreamParser.java} and core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/datamatrix/DataMatrixReader.java, plus core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/datamatrix/decoder/DecodedBitStreamParserTestCase.java. The package has only one production incoming dependency from DataMatrixReader (it instantiates Decoder); I found no other main-code imports into this package. Its outgoing dependencies are mainly to shared core packages like com.google.zxing.common, com.google.zxing.common.reedsolomon, and com.google.zxing.FormatException/ChecksumException. With minimal incoming usage and dependencies aimed at central shared packages, there is no evidence that this package is a stable package depending on less-stable ones.
